kv13.7:1.3: Taṃ jhānaṃ tassa jhānassa ārammaṇan ti?
kv13.7:1.5: Taṃ jhānaṃ tassa jhānassa ārammaṇan ti?
kv13.7:1.7: Tena phassena taṃ phassaṃ phusati, tāya vedanāya taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti, tāya saññāya taṃ saññaṃ jānāti, tāya cetanāya taṃ cetanaṃ ceteti, tena cittena taṃ cittaṃ cinteti, tena vitakkena taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi, tena vicārena taṃ vicāraṃ vicāreti, tāya pītiyā taṃ pītiṃ piyāyati, tāya satiyā taṃ satiṃ sarati, tāya paññāya taṃ paññaṃ pajānātīti?
kv13.7:3.3: Kusalākusalā sāvajjānavajjā hīnapaṇītā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantīti?
kv13.7:4.1: Kusalākusalā sāvajjānavajjā hīnappaṇītā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantīti?
kv13.7:4.7: idaṃ paṭhamaṃ suvidūravidūraṃ -- pe -- tasmā sataṃ dhammo asabbhi ārakā ti."
kv13.7:5.5: "Idha Bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicc' akusalehi dhammehi paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, so taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati,
kv13.7:5.8: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, so taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjatīti"?
kv13.7:5.11: Tena hi samāpanno assādeti, jhānanikanti jhānārammaṇā ti.
